disc: Ye checklist hai, kanooni salah nahi. Sign karne se pehle ek lawyer se poochhein.

h1: Sign karne se pehle, jaan lo.
read: Aapka agreement padha ja raha hai…
readsub: Aapki file save nahi hoti. Sirf wahi padha jata hai jo check karna hai.
s1p: WhatsApp, files ya camera se. 20 MB tak, ya 8 photos.

s3p: Green, amber ya red — aur sabse pehle theek karne wali zyada se zyada 3 cheezein, builder ko bhejne wale sawalon ke saath.
sub: Apna builder-buyer agreement upload karo. 2 minute se kam mein jaano kaunsi shartein poochni hain — seedhe shabdon mein, kanooni bhasha mein nahi.
tooManyPhotos: Ek analysis mein zyada se zyada 8 photos — 8 ya kam chunein.
photosNote: PDF ya order mein zyada se zyada 8 photos.
